A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CRS research. The main text, equations, figures, tables and complete appendices are readable and can be matched despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-generation experiments with trained latent-space and pixel-space diffusion models, including FID, sFID, precision and recall in Section 5 and Appendix E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and reports revised training-baseline comparisons in Section 5 and Appendix D.

M1.justification: The FID-based CRS construction and relative-step constraint R remain. A limited sampling-algorithm refinement appears: v2 Algorithm 2 accepts alpha_max and updates only interior noise levels, whereas v1 Algorithm 1 fixes the upper endpoint at 1 and also updates alpha_0.

E1.justification: Both evaluate LSUN Church, Bedroom, Cat and Horse, ImageNet and FFHQ, with the same unconditional/class-conditional image-generation tasks and pixel-space/latent-space coverage. The added parameter study uses the existing LSUN Cat setting.

E2.justification: Adaptive VDM++ replaces fixed EDM training in the Church and ImageNet comparisons (v1 Tables 13–14; v2 Tables 9 and 14). The LDM reference rows for Church and Bedroom and the ADM reference row for Horse disappear. EDM sampling, AYS and the retained sampler comparisons remain.

E3.justification: The added parameter study introduces xi/R sweeps. Reported schedule formulas also change: v2 Table 7 revises the cosine schedule and replaces v1's EDM alpha = 1/sqrt(1+exp(-lambda)) with sigmoid(lambda). These are reported protocol revisions; corresponding reruns are not established. Training budgets, checkpoint selection and 50K-sample evaluation remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Figure 2 varies xi over 0.5, 1.0 and 1.2 and R over 0.1, 0.05 and 0.03, showing their effects on CRS curves for LSUN Cat. This adds schedule-shape sensitivity analysis, without testing generation-quality sensitivity.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests for the generation results. Selecting among ten checkpoints is retained and does not constitute repeated-run uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: VDM++ results replace EDM-training results, rather than demonstrating a same-method performance gain. Three CRS rows change for LSUN Cat at NFE 250: DPM-Solver++(2M) FID changes from 5.58 to 5.41, while SDE-DPM-Solver++(2M) FID changes from 5.25 to 5.26 and sFID from 6.48 to 6.66. Most other sampling scores are identical.

T1.justification: Section 4.2 changes the sign of the CRS evolution equation and generalizes its endpoint normalization. The log-SNR denominator changes from lambda squared in v1 Equation 47 to sigma squared in v2 Section 5. The reverse-process derivation is streamlined; no new theorem or proof framework is introduced.

C1.justification: The core claims remain automatic dataset/model-adapted schedules, applicability to training and sampling, flexibility in distance metrics and broad generation benefits. v2 merges two contribution bullets without removing their substance.

C2.justification: v2 Section 5.2 specifically attributes unsuccessful pixel-space CRS training to poor high-noise features and insufficient training there, extending v1's general feature-model concern. It removes the separate concern about transferring ImageNet features to other datasets and the self-supervised-feature suggestion, while adding explicit qualifications to the Church comparisons.

D1.justification: v2 discloses the 1,000-point rate-estimation grid, its pixel/latent exponents, interpolation and setup costs: 12 hours for ImageNet and 32 hours for LSUN Cat on eight A100s. However, new Algorithm 1 omits the feature map when forming statistics, whereas v1 Appendix B explicitly applies it, introducing a reproducibility inconsistency.

R1.justification: Section 2 recharacterizes AYS from minimizing data/generated-distribution KL divergence to minimizing reverse-SDE discretization errors. The previously cited Kingma–Gao work gains an evaluated VDM++ role, and the Lopez-Paz–Oquab citation is removed. The SDXL publication update represents the same work.

P1.justification: The narrative is substantially reorganized and edited: distance computation and sampling pseudocode move into the main method section, training-loss exposition is recast, main results emphasize ImageNet/Cat, and discussion and conclusion merge. The detailed-results appendix gains extensive explanatory prose.

P2.justification: The main text and references switch from one to two columns. Training/sampling schedule tables merge, benchmark displays move between main text and appendices, and appendix tables gain training-schedule columns and selection markings. Figure 2 is added, existing schedule plots are redrawn, and retained sample plates are enlarged and reordered.

improvement.justification: v2 adds a useful adaptive VDM++ comparison, parameter analysis and CRS setup costs. However, v1 explicitly computes feature-space statistics, while v2 Algorithm 1 omits the feature map; v2 Table 7 also replaces the earlier square-root alpha mapping with sigmoid(lambda), conflicting with its variance-preserving/log-SNR definitions. Some reference comparisons and limitations disappear. The benefits coexist with new reproducibility inconsistencies whose effect on the reported experiments is unresolved, preventing a reliable net quality judgment.
